protocol.policy_rationale: Declared before new integrations: reduce desired CFL from 0.75 to 0.5 and global dt_max from 2 s to 0.1 s. Preserve the 0.1 s moving-source cap and 0.02 s initial step. Adaptive actual steps may differ. No tuning after outcomes.
protocol.acceptance: Unchanged simulation.time_steps.audit and simulation.validate plus original input/monitor/deck consistency checks; additionally enforce the declared global time-step ceiling. Failed cases excluded. Stop expansion on any failure.
protocol.refinement: Exactly double nx and ny. Keep original nodal terrain, artificial masks, source grid, source history and domain. Reintegrate nodal terrain and final displacement onto new cells using existing cell_average; do not resample or retune physical source.
